request.title: Admin-only chat actions (dump) gating
request.content:
Admin-only chat actions (e.g. the postmortem "Dump chat" JSON export) follow this pattern in codx-junior-client:

- `ChatView.vue` owns the permission decision: computed `isAdminUser()` reads `this.$storex?.user` defensively (`is_admin` → `isAdmin` → `roles.includes('admin')` → `role === 'admin'`) and **fails closed** (unknown user store ⇒ button hidden). Computed `canDumpChat()` lets a host override via the `dumpEnabled` prop.
- `ChatViewHeader.vue` stays dumb: it only receives `canDump` (Boolean, default false) and emits `show-dump`.
- The feature lives in its own dialog component (`ChatDumpDialog.vue`) wrapped by the global `<modal>` in `ChatView.vue`; it offers **Download .json** (Blob + object URL) and **Copy to clipboard** (`navigator.clipboard` with a `execCommand('copy')` textarea fallback), plus a truncated `<pre>` preview.
- Dumps are admin/sensitive: always show a warning row, include every message (hidden ones too), summarized children, run and environment diagnostics, and `dump_version` + `exported_at` in the manifest.

request.title: Admin-only chat dump (postmortem export)
request.content:
Chat dump is an **admin-only** postmortem export of a whole chat as JSON.

- Permission is resolved in `ChatView.vue` (`isAdminUser`, read defensively from `$storex.user`, **fails closed**). Hosts may override with the `dumpEnabled` prop.
- Child components never decide permissions: `ChatViewHeader` receives `canDump` and emits `show-dump`; `ChatSidebar` receives `canDump` and emits `action: { type: 'dump' }`.
- `ChatView.handleSidebarAction` already maps `'dump'` → `showDumpChat = true`.
- The dialog is `src/components/chat/ChatDumpDialog.vue` (payload: `dump_version`, `exporter`, `summary`, full `chat` incl. hidden messages, `children`, `environment`, `diagnostics`). Export surface = download `.json` + copy to clipboard.
- Never dumb down the payload: postmortems need hidden/system messages, so `includeHidden` defaults to `true`.

request.content:
## Scope rule

All changes must be made in the **base code only** (`/client/src/...`).

- Never read-and-edit files that live inside `.worktrees/**` (e.g. `.worktrees/mobile_redesign/client/src/...`).
